statement: For every homomorphism C_p to full GT_0 with p-adic multiplier one (automatic for odd p), the rank-two semidirect product has exactly one kernel-conjugacy class of order-p sections, every cusp normalizer contains a section, and inclusion of the actual fixed subgroup induces an isomorphism of maximal pro-p quotients. A proper fixed subgroup of an explicit order-three automorphism has this same pro-p quotient; that automorphism fails the third cusp in D_7.
manuscript_passages: Part D(a) of the task: actual full GT_0 torsion
notes: Exact normalizer norm equation solved coordinatewise using the quotient to F2^(p) times C_p. Brown restriction forces uniqueness and first-cohomology rank two, and projectivity gives the displayed maximal pro-p isomorphism. D.32 then uses the three actual cusp subgroups and finite covers to prove C=F and exclude every such nonidentity GT_0 action. D.34 determines the remaining involution multiplier globally; D.35 and D.44 give the exact remaining conjugator equation and its proved first-symmetry adjustment.
